subject.title: fix(memory): use FTS-only when optional embeddings are unavailable

question: Should memory search return read-only FTS results from an existing semantic index when an optional embedding provider becomes unavailable and sync is intentionally refused?
rationale: This is a valid compatibility and data-freshness tradeoff rather than a mechanical correctness question: keyword recall improves availability, but the index can no longer reflect later source changes.

options.title: Approve read-only FTS fallback
options.body: Allow FTS recall from the preserved index while sync remains blocked, accepting that status must make the stale/read-only condition visible.

options.title: Keep paused behavior
options.body: Require the optional embedding provider to return before exposing results from an existing semantic index, prioritizing freshness over degraded recall.

recommendation.title: Approve read-only FTS fallback
recommendation.body: Allow FTS recall from the preserved index while sync remains blocked, accepting that status must make the stale/read-only condition visible.
